When Sam's friend, Suzi Moto, is charged with burning down her New York fashion show, all evidence points to her purchase of a kimono Rip believes is cursed.
Sh'lainn's death vision predicts everyone at the Alliance base will die in twelve hours...
Logan and Fitz are missing and presumed dead while on a mission to locate a downed alien ship in Haiti...
The full moon has come again, and the girls are taking every precaution they can imagine this time. It proves to be in vain, however, when Rikki falls under the spell.

Cleo and Kim are fighting like crazy and Cleo is pushed to breaking point. Then cousin Angela comes to stay and things just get worse. Cleo realises there are more challenging things than an annoying sister.
Lewis enters the annual fishing derby. When Cleo sees him struggling, she decides to help him out with disastorous consequnces. Meanwhile, Rikki and Zane are trapped on a hotel balcony.

Zane thinks Miss Chatham holds the key to the sea monster. Emma needs a change so dyes her hair red. While Zane gets closer to the secret, he also gets closer to Rikki. Zane dives to Miss Chatham’s boat and sees a mermaid!

Emma and Cleo find out Zane and Rikki are an item and force her to choose – him or them. When Zane appears to side with Harrison over the Mako island development Rikki’s decision is clear. Now it’s Zane’s turn to make a choice…

The girls discover a necklace for sale identical to Miss Chatham’s. Miriam causes a stir by buying it – then throwing it in the water. Rikki faces a choice whether to take the necklace and reveal her mermaidness to Zane.
Benkei continues to train Bladers, with Kite, Eight, and Ren joining Shinobu, and Zyro.
While on a beach vacation, Zyro and the others solve a mystery about a supposed Sea Monster.
Zyro and his friends are sent by the WBBA to show bladers around the world how much fun beyblading in the new Cyclone Beystadium can be.
Shinobu Hiryuin and his Ninja Salamander are defeated by Sakyo Kurayami and his Ronin Dragoon.
A Blader named Yoshio Iwayama comes to town and defeats both Eight and Kite Unabara.
Ren and Shinobu train with Zyro. Takanosuke defeats Kikura, but he then loses to Kite Unabara.
Tim the Witchsmeller is a disgruntled half witch who can perform no magic, and boy is he bitter.
Salem eats Sabrina's prize mouse for her science fair exhibit. After much blackmailing on Sabrina's part, she gets Salem to morph into a mouse to take its place.
Sabrina is psyched about school dance and can't understand why Harvey doesn't want to go.
Salem falls for a fellow feline. He learns that she is a kittywitch as well. They fall in love and want to run off together.
Harvey lacks the courage to show his comic book to the great comic book creator, King Kirby. Sabrina decides to give Harvey a wishing star in hopes that he'll wish for courage.
Betty begins to mysteriously receive fortune cookies that instruct her to carry out simple good deeds each of which leads to a reward.
When a sunken treasure is found off the coast of Riverdale, Reggie succumbs to the greedy curse of the pirate's gold.
Spooky and mysterious things are happening at Riverdale High.
Rikki tries to avoid Zane when he comes back, but needs his help after an incident with a speedboat. Meanwhile, Charlotte continues to flirt with Lewis and Cleo worries for their secret.

Cleo and Rikki push Ash into asking Emma out again – little did they know he’d turn up at Emma’s place in time for a full moon! Rikki and Cleo are both moonstruck and Ash looks set to discover Emma’s secret.
For the first anniversary of the girls being mermaids, Cleo decides to throw a party. However, Emma and Rikki fall out following a fight between Ash and Zane and Cleo may have to celebrate alone.

Lewis discovers someone called Max Hamilton did research fifty years ago on the strange properties of Mako Island. Lewis tracks the old man down and finds that he knows a lot more about mermaids than Lewis first thought.

Charlotte demands answers to why Lewis is hanging out with the girls so much. She believe an excuse from Cleo, but then a discovery from inside Max's research brings her to the secret! Meanwhile, Ash decides to help Emma with her fear of water.
Trickery makes Marshall the new Harvest King, and he finds the king's traditional task no treat: he must venture to see the Eerie Wolf, which turns out to be a werewolf.
Marshall and Simon must really use their heads to crack open the real story behind a homeless man who seems to have lost his mind.
Convinced that his Aunt Melva is too old and helpless to live on her own, a young city boy named Dale drives out to the "sticks" to retrieve her.
Wendell has had his share of bullying from pranksters Chet and Louie.
When neighbourhood Ghost, Goblin and Troll Expert "Sheldon" tells his best buddy Eddie that there's a Troll under the bridge and it's following him home.

Kasimir is stunned when she loses a Scootsoomer race to Lucrezia. Gus thinks Kazz is obsessed with winning and refuses to listen when Kazz says she thinks Lucrezia cheated. Kazz discovers a Leprechaun was forced to help her cheat and Zarlak.

In an adjacent town, Scott picks up a flamingo sink for his dad's customer. While leaving the shop, he falls down a manhole and loses his memory. Scott explores all over the town in order to remember his identity, and his family goes searching for him.
After Scott and his rock band perform a song on a televised talent show, Scott is discovered by a record label that wants to sign him.
Scott visits his cousin, Todd, but the two have nothing in common. As Scott tries to help Todd come out of his shell, he realizes that he and his cousin are much more alike than he initially thought.
Scott's family album of werewolves gets mixed up in the back of Mick's car. He and his friend Stiles hunt it down in order to protect the Howard family secret.

programmes.t: Archie's Weird Mysteries: The Day the Earth Moved
programmes.d: Giant, toothy-mawed worms the size of freight trains are plowing beneath the grounds of an old section of Riverdale, eating cars, buildings and anything they can detect moving on the surface.

programmes.t: Archie's Weird Mysteries: Dance of the Killer Bees
programmes.d: Humanoid bee creatures begin causing trouble for the people of Riverdale after their leader, the Queen Bee, decides to make the attic of Riverdale High her new hive.

'Lights, Camera, Voodoo': Security guard Panther comes up against an egotistical star, a demented director and an obsessive fan at a movie studio. 'I'm Dreaming of a Pink Christmas': Pinky tries to instill the spirit of Christmas in a 'scrooge.'

'Wiener Takes All': The Panther runs a successful hot dog business until the competition kidnaps the founding granny. 'The Easter Panther': When the Panther is hired to handle the White House Easter Egg Hunt, he must foil a heist by the Dogfather.

Robotnik's next stop in his time-travel is the time of King Arfur and the Knights of the Round Table to get the Emerald of Invincibility. Sonic follows him, but Robotnik, with the unwilling help of local wizard Merlynx, obtains the Emerald.
In his next time-travel stop, Robotnik is erasing Sonic's family tree in order to get the Chaos Emerald of Immortality. Sonic goes after him, prevent Robotnik from interfering with his ancestors.
Despite the intervention of Sonic and Tails, Robotnik obtains the Chaos Emerald of life in prehistory and the other emeralds and becomes the Supreme High Robotnik.

Sonic and Tails babysit a trio of unruly baby beavers who end up being abducted by Scratch and Grounder. Robotnik uses the beavers as bait to capture Sonic and Tails, but the beavers become resourceful and help their friends thwart Robotnik.
The beautiful M.A.D. agent Labella is disrupting the peaceful country of Pianostan. Inspector Gadget stops her before she causes a revolution.
Dr. Claw is kidnapping billionaires and stealing their money. Inspector Gadget rescues the captured billionaires and protects their money.

During a visit to Buckingham Palace, Mr. Bean meets the lady of the house. When Mr. Bean breaks his favourite Royal mug he discovers there's only one place to buy a replacement: Buckingham Palace, home of the Queen of England

Mr. Bean takes a trip down Memory Lane. When did Mr. Bean first meet his teddy bear? Did he really learn to drive his mini at the age of ten? Could he possibly have known his battle-axe of a landlady when she was a sweet and blushing bride?

Mr. Bean, badgered by a strange pink animal, warms to the creature when it shows its true colours. Mr. Bean finds himself lumbered with an unwanted pet in the form of a four-legged ball of pink fur with piggy eyes and a penchant for earthworms.
When invited to dinner by Mr. Bean, it’s probably best to take your own sandwiches. Mr. Bean forgets the golden rule: never fall asleep in the bath when you've got a chicken in the oven.
Mr. Bean makes it to the top of the ladder… and gets stuck. The nasty tennis player is big and angry and wants his ball back. The one Mr. Bean managed to throw on the roof of a house across the road.
The BION team travel to London to bid on the Winged Warrior Helmet, said to give the wearer the strength of ten.
